feeds.title: Crude Oil Peak
feeds.description: Crude Oil Peak provides relevant information and offers opinions on the declining global crude oil reserves, Conventional Gas peaks, Power crisis and more. Crude Oil Peak is one of the Top sources for monitoring the Crude Peak as well as global production of other conventional fuel sources.

feeds.title: Our Finite World
feeds.description: Gail Tverberg is a researcher focused on figuring out how energy limits and the economy are really interconnected, and what this means for our future. Her background is as a casualty actuary, working in insurance forecasting. Follow along as she explores how Oil limits affect the economy.

feeds.title: Peak Oil Barrel
feeds.description: The Peak Oil Barrel talks about Oil Production, OPEC, Natural Gas Production, Existing Reserves and Resources, and many more topically relevant categories. Articles by Author Ron Patterson diving into Peak Oil predictions and analysis are featured here.

feeds.title: Peak Oil
feeds.description: Peak Oil.net is one of the leading green voices throughout the internet with special attention on new and expanding markets that prioritize sustainability. We focus on delivering green news and tips with a down-to-earth approach that anyone can apply to their daily life.

feeds.title: Peak Oil
feeds.description: View articles that explore the issue of hydrocarbon depletion in the U.S and the world. PeakOil.com is a strictly non-commercial & non-affiliated news aggregation and a message-board social networking news site. We are an online community run for and by the members.

feeds.title: The Energy Bulletin
feeds.description: The Energy Bulletin brings you daily news covering Global oil prices, Oil supply, and other International Stories concerning Imports & Exports of Oil. The Energy Bulletin is updated regularly by Tom Whipple, a highly respected analyst of peak oil issues in the United States.
